title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Damage Report Periods, Allowance Percentages and Replacement Lead Times
content:
The Ridgeline Special Order Services programs differ in how long a customer has to report shipping damage after pickup or delivery, in the damage allowance percentage, in free reordering of a damaged or wrong item and in the lead time of the replacement.

## Terms

- **Damage report period** — hours after pickup or delivery within which shipping damage must be reported for a free replacement or allowance.
- **Damage allowance percentage** — the allowance offered, as a percentage of the item price, to a customer who keeps an item with cosmetic damage; 0 means no allowance is offered.
- **Free reorder** — whether a damaged or wrong item reported in time is reordered at no charge.
- **Replacement lead time** — calendar days from the damage report to the new promised ready date of a replacement.

## Program table

| Program | Damage report period (hours) | Damage allowance percentage | Free reorder | Replacement lead time (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 48 | 10 | yes | 7 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 48 | 10 | yes | 10 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 72 | 0 | yes | 14 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 48 | 15 | yes | 28 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 72 | 15 | yes | 35 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 48 | 0 | yes | 14 |

## Reading the table

- Made-to-Measure Window Coverings and Fabricated Countertops show a damage allowance percentage of 0: those programs offer no allowance for keeping a cosmetically damaged item.
- Every program reorders a damaged or wrong item reported in time at no charge.
- A hypothetical Semi-Custom Cabinetry damage report on 3 May gives a replacement promised ready date 35 days later, 7 June.
